Ormira Brackett had moved to Wilcombe.  
Answer: Wilcombe.

Ormira Brackett was living in Wilcombe at the time Molan Velloway died.  
Answer: Wilcombe.

Pemira Velloway married Dabin Wexson and had a son named Febin Wexson. Later, she left Larkmere and settled in Salford. There is no information indicating she married anyone else after that. Answer: Dabin Wexson.
Febin Wexson took Wedette Brackett in marriage at Larkmere. Wedette Brackett went along to live in Ravenhaven as well. Answer: Wedette Brackett.

Dabin Wexson is married to Pemira Velloway.  
Answer: Pemira Velloway.

The copper comb was held by Garald Fellwood immediately before its current holder, Red Ormira, who won it from Garald Fellwood at cards. 

Answer: Garald Fellwood.

The silver ring was held by Pewyn Stenoway immediately before its current holder, who is Orrald Stenoway. Pewyn Stenoway gave the silver ring to Orrald Stenoway. 

Answer: Pewyn Stenoway.

The amber flute was held by Pedan Ashmere before it was given to Elra Ashmere.  
Answer: Pedan Ashmere.

Ilra Brackett was born in the village of Larkholt.  
Answer: Larkholt.

Isdette Brackett was born in Mireford.  
Answer: Mireford.

Jolan Wexwood was born at Larkhaven.  
Answer: Larkhaven.

Pemira Velloway was born in Wilcombe.  
Answer: Wilcombe.

Colis Velloway was born at Wilholt.  
Answer: Wilholt.

Chapter 1 | ¶119] Zamor Stenoway was born at Mireholt.
Answer: Mireholt.

Isbin Brackett was born in Salford.  
Answer: Salford.

Answer: Salford.
